_readme: Sound names used in shot lists (sfx: [[t, 'name', dB]]). The mixer looks for project/sfx/<name>.mp3|wav, then sfx/eleven/<name>.mp3, then sfx/synth/<name>.mp3. 'prompt' is the ElevenLabs text used to make our own version (npm run sfx:gen). Every prompt describes an ORIGINAL effect in plain words: no meme clips, no copyrighted music, no game audio.

bed.prompt: Playful sneaky cartoon comedy underscore, pizzicato strings, bouncy upright bass, light marimba and soft brushed drums, mischievous kid-sitcom mood, steady 112 bpm, loopable, no vocals, no melody hooks from existing songs

tv_off.prompt: Television switched off: sharp plastic click followed by a short descending electronic power-down zap

tv_on.prompt: Television turning on: an electronic blip and a soft rising hum

mom_hmm.prompt: Short angry wordless woman's grunt 'HMM!' through closed lips, cartoon style, no words

mom_roar.prompt: Cartoon mother's furious wordless roar, huge exaggerated angry growl that builds, no words, comedic

mom_cackle.prompt: Middle-aged woman's quiet wordless evil cackle, hehehe, gleeful at night, no words

kid_gasp.prompt: A young boy's sharp shocked wordless gasp, cartoon, no words

kid_wail.prompt: Young boy's wordless despairing cartoon wail 'AAAAH', comedic anguish, no words

kid_chuckle.prompt: Young boy's mischievous wordless evil chuckle, heh heh heh, cartoon, no words

kid_whine.prompt: Small child's pleading wordless whine, a rising 'nnnnn?' puppy-dog begging sound, cartoon, no words

kid_tantrum.prompt: Small child's wordless furious tantrum scream, a big wailing 'WAAAAH' that cracks, comedic cartoon meltdown, no words

kid_giggle.prompt: Small child's sweet innocent wordless giggle, hee hee, cartoon, no words

pot_bell.prompt: Metal ladle banging hard on a steel cooking pot three quick times like a dinner bell

game_car.prompt: Arcade video game sports car revving and accelerating away with a tyre squeal, bright synthy game sound

mission_start.prompt: Short punchy original retro synth video game 'mission start' sting, rising arpeggio and a hit, 1 second

mission_done.prompt: Short triumphant original retro synth video game victory fanfare, mission complete jingle

tiptoe.prompt: Cartoon sneaking tiptoe footsteps played as soft staccato pizzicato plucks, comedic stealth

night_amb.prompt: Quiet living room at night: soft clock ticking, faint distant crickets, gentle room tone

mash.prompt: Game controller buttons mashed rapidly, fast plastic clicking and thumbstick taps

boing.prompt: Cartoon spring boing, bouncy and springy, short

record_scratch.prompt: Vinyl record scratch that stops the music abruptly, short and comedic

sting.prompt: Dramatic orchestral shock stab, low brass and screeching strings hit, short comedic horror sting

slide_down.prompt: Slide whistle gliding down in pitch, cartoon flop

slide_up.prompt: Slide whistle gliding quickly up in pitch, cartoon

dun_dun.prompt: Comedic suspense reveal: three dramatic brass and timpani hits, dun, dun, DUNNN, the last hit long and big

squeak_steps.prompt: Cartoon sneaking tiptoe footsteps made of tiny rubber squeaks, comedic stealth

boom.prompt: Huge cinematic boom impact with deep sub bass and a crash, exaggerated cartoon

stomp.prompt: Heavy cartoon footstep stomp, big thud on a wooden floor with a small rattle

door_bang.prompt: Door flung open hard: a quick creak and a loud bang against the wall

door_creak.prompt: Slow quiet creaky door hinge, suspenseful, short

zip.prompt: Fast cartoon zip whoosh for a quick movement

eye_pop.prompt: Cartoon eyes popping out: a quick rubbery pop followed by a springy wobble

flump.prompt: Body flopping back onto a soft couch cushion, fluffy thump with a spring creak

scramble.prompt: Cartoon frantic scramble: feet scrabbling on a cushion, fabric slipping, flailing

bonk.prompt: Cartoon bonk, hollow woodblock knock with a little twang

steps_angry.prompt: Angry footsteps marching quickly closer on a wooden floor, four heavy steps

yoink.prompt: Quick cartoon snatch: a swipe whoosh ending in a rubbery pop

sad_trombone.prompt: Sad descending muted trombone, wah wah wah wahhh, comedic failure

knuckles.prompt: Knuckles cracking, a quick series of popping cracks, cartoon

click.prompt: Single game controller button press, crisp small plastic click

pop.prompt: Small bright cartoon pop, like a menu item appearing

pop2.prompt: Soft rising cartoon bloop pop for a head peeking into view

tap.prompt: Light hollow tap, a finger tapping wood once

thump.prompt: Dull soft thump of something landing on a carpet

ticks.prompt: Wall clock ticking four times, quiet and dry

stamp.prompt: Rubber stamp slammed down once on a desk, short punchy comedic accent

whoosh.prompt: Short airy whoosh of an arm swinging fast
